svg.title: ebisu homelab topology
svg.desc: Two WAN links behind CGNAT feed vmbr1 and vmbr2 into the OPNsense VM hermes, which routes four segments on the vmbr0 trunk: Management, DMZ, TRUST and Security. Shows planned services, storage, the access point, the admin laptop, break-glass cable, and a planned standalone second node.
svg.text: Physical and logical layout. Subnets and addresses are omitted; real values live outside this repository.
Dell OptiPlex 7050 · i7-6700 · 31 GiB RAM · runs 24/7
gateway group 'failover': WAN1 tier 1, WAN2 tier 2
vtnet1 = WAN1 · vtnet2 = WAN2 · vtnet0 = VLAN trunk
removed via MCP at the end
boot: 1 TB SATA SSD, ZFS (keep heavy writes off)
single physical path for every VLAN
last resort, needs nothing else working
